description: Turns an incoming phasor into a stepped random voltage, with a fresh value arriving as each step comes round

params.text: How many steps the phasor cycle is cut into, 1 to 64, at 16 by default
Scales the STEPS CV before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1; at full depth 5V spans the whole 64-step range
How often a step is given a fresh random value as it comes round: never fully counter-clockwise, every time fully clockwise
Scales the PROBABILITY CV before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1
Picks the output range, 0-10V or -5V to +5V

inputs.text: The phasor that clocks the steps
Modulates the step count, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob
Modulates how often a value is refreshed, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob

outputs.text: The random voltage for the current step, held flat until the next step begins
The random step voltages with a straight ramp running from each value to the next

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
